movelist.name: Swagger
movelist.effect: The target’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages. Swagger Confuses the target.

movelist.name: Assurance
movelist.effect: When you hit with Assurance, if Assurance’s target has already been damaged by a Move on the same round Assurance is being used, Assurance has a Damage Base of 12 (3d12+10 / 30) instead. This effect may trigger only once per Scene per Target.

movelist.name: Night Shade
movelist.effect: The target loses Hit Points equal to the level of Night Shade’s user. Do not apply weakness or resistance. Do not apply stats.

movelist.name: Haze
movelist.effect: The Combat Stages of the user and all Pokémon and Trainers in the encounter are set to their default state (usually 0).

movelist.name: Pursuit
movelist.effect: If the foe is fleeing or being switched out, Pursuit may be used as an Interrupt, targeting the triggering foe. When used as an Interrupt, Pursuit grants the user a +5 bonus to all Movement Speeds, and has a Damage Base of 8 (2d8+10 / 19).

abilities.name: Super Luck
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Moves are Critical Hits on 18-20. If a Move already has an extended Critical Hit range, Super Luck extends that range by 2.

abilities.name: Confidence
abilities.effect: Choose a Combat Stat. All allies within 5 meters of the user gain +1 CS in the Chosen Stat.
